AfricaNenda's SIIPS 2024 case study profiles MauCAS as Mauritius's national instant-payment switch for interoperable, real-time retail payments.
Platform Africa reports Mauritius has made progress on payments and interoperability, and customers can move funds between their bank accounts through fintech platforms.
The article, citing the 2021 COMESA report, states mobile account holding in Mauritius is at 6% of adults, so mobile accounts are in use.
Mobile payments in Mauritius grew more than tenfold from Rs 1.8 billion to Rs 25.7 billion between February 2020 and April 2025, per the Bank of Mauritius governor.
The governor says the 24-hour MauCAS Instant Payment System facilitates interoperability between banking services, e-commerce and mobile payments.
